title: brassica frutescens
intro: Brassica frutescens, commonly known as Wild Mustard, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family, which includes mustard, cabbage, and broccoli. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Brassica frutescens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
